canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Cori Zharor: 35-year-old woman, 173 cm (medium), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, long-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: an extensive patchwork of ordinary ink marks across the arms and upper back. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.
